description: This source file defines the internal class AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageProvider, implementing IStateMachineStorageProvider and ILifecycleParticipant, responsible for managing Azure Blob Storage based state machine storage within Orleans framework, including initialization and blob container management.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageProvider
